headline: Demand outpaces capacity; ramp-up underway

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Eicher Motors Demand outpaces capacity; ramp-up underway Auto & Auto Ancillaries  Result Update  November 14, 2026 CMP (Rs): 7,675 | TP (Rs): 9,100 EIM RE delivered a steady 2Q, with revenue/EBITDA up 20%/16% (4%/7% below our estimates) and EBITDAM at 23.7% (80bps below our estimates).

RE demand continues to outpace capacity, reflected in ~2M waiting period for select models, ~20% yoy growth in bookings and enquiries, and lean channel inventory of 7-8 days (vs the normal 3-4 weeks).
The management expects the strong demand trajectory to sustain in 2H, supported by broad-based growth across markets and phased capacity additions.
VECV demand is also broad-based across rural, semi-urban, and urban markets, with the management expecting strong momentum in 4Q.
valuation: Earnings call highlights 1) RE reported record 2Q volumes of 377k units (+15% yoy), with bookings/enquiries up 20- 21% and waiting periods of up to ~2M for select models. 2) Channel inventory remains lean at 7-8 days (vs normal 3-4 weeks), with the management targeting restocking over the next 2M. 3) Rural/semi-urban demand remains healthy, with UP, WB, Bihar, and Rajasthan growing >20% in 1HFY27.
